description: Crawl pages or XML sitemaps and extract every image reference with alt text, dimensions, format and provenance. Supports img/lazy attributes, srcset, picture sources, icons, CSS backgrounds, Open Graph/Twitter images and JSON-LD.

acceptExtensionlessImages.description: Many CDNs serve images from paths like /media/abc123?w=800. Keep them when on; when off, only URLs with an accepted extension are emitted.
acceptExtensionlessImages.title: Accept image URLs without a file extension

crawlSitemapPages.description: When on, page URLs from regular (non-image) sitemaps are fetched and parsed for images, not just <image:loc> entries. Bounded by Maximum pages.
crawlSitemapPages.title: Also crawl pages listed in sitemaps (sitemap mode)

excludeTrackingPixels.description: Drop declared 1x1 images and common pixel/beacon/spacer/blank image names.
excludeTrackingPixels.title: Exclude tracking pixels

fetchExternalStylesheets.description: Also download up to 5 same-host CSS files per page to find background-image URLs. Adds requests; leave off for the fastest runs.
fetchExternalStylesheets.title: Fetch same-host stylesheets

fetchImageMetadata.description: Request each image URL to add content type, byte size, last-modified and HTTP status. Adds one small request per unique image.
fetchImageMetadata.sectionDescription: Optional enrichment for each unique image URL. Leave off to keep runs fast and cheap.
fetchImageMetadata.title: Fetch image headers (HEAD)

followPagination.description: Follow next-page links (rel=next, pager containers, and links whose text is 'next'). Bounded by Maximum pages.
followPagination.title: Follow pagination links (crawl mode)

imageExtensions.description: Keep only image URLs whose path ends in one of these extensions. Extensionless URLs are controlled separately.
imageExtensions.sectionDescription: Choose which image sources to read and which records to keep. Empty fields are omitted from each record.
imageExtensions.title: Accepted file extensions

includeBackgroundImages.description: Emit URLs from inline style background declarations and <style> blocks.
includeBackgroundImages.title: Include CSS background images

includeIcons.description: Emit icon, shortcut icon and apple-touch-icon links.
includeIcons.title: Include favicons / icon links

includeMetaImages.description: Emit og:image, twitter:image, image_src, and image/logo/thumbnailUrl values from JSON-LD blocks.
includeMetaImages.title: Include Open Graph, Twitter and JSON-LD images

includeSrcset.description: Emit each candidate URL from img/srcset and picture/source srcset, with its width or density descriptor.
includeSrcset.title: Include srcset candidates

includeSubdomains.description: Also follow links on subdomains of the starting host (e.g. blog.example.com when starting at example.com).
includeSubdomains.title: Allow subdomains (crawl mode)

maxCrawlDepth.description: 0 = only the start URLs. 1 = also follow links on those pages. Higher values widen the crawl; pagination pages do not consume depth.
maxCrawlDepth.title: Maximum crawl depth (crawl mode)

maxImagesPerPage.description: Cap on unique image records collected from a single page before moving on.
maxImagesPerPage.title: Maximum images per page

maxPages.description: Hard cap on page or sitemap-document requests per run. In sitemap mode this includes sitemap indexes and their children.
maxPages.title: Maximum pages / sitemap files

maxTotalImages.description: Hard cap on unique image records emitted. The crawl stops once this many records are collected.
maxTotalImages.title: Maximum images per run

metadataConcurrency.description: How many image HEAD requests run in parallel when header fetching is on.
metadataConcurrency.title: Image header concurrency

minHeight.description: 0 = no minimum. Images without a declared height are excluded when this is above 0.
minHeight.title: Minimum declared height (px)

minWidth.description: 0 = no minimum. Images without a declared width or srcset width descriptor are excluded when this is above 0.
minWidth.title: Minimum declared width (px)

mode.description: Crawl a website (follow links and pagination), read only specific pages, or read XML sitemaps (including image sitemaps).
mode.sectionDescription: Choose a mode, then paste one or more URLs. In sitemap mode, paste sitemap XML URLs (an HTML page with a sitemap link also works).
mode.title: Mode

paginationSelector.description: Extra CSS selector for next-page links (e.g. '.pagination a.next'). Auto-detection still runs.
paginationSelector.title: Pagination link CSS selector (optional)

requestTimeoutSecs.description: Per-request timeout for pages, sitemaps and image headers. Retries handle 429/5xx responses.
requestTimeoutSecs.sectionDescription: Networking overrides. The defaults work for almost every site.
requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)

requireAltText.description: Keep only images that have a non-empty alt attribute — useful for accessibility audits.
requireAltText.title: Only images with alt text

sameHostOnly.description: When on, only links whose host matches a start URL are followed. Turn off to crawl external links too (still bounded by Maximum pages).
sameHostOnly.title: Stay on the starting host (crawl mode)

startUrls.description: Page URLs for crawl/pages mode, or sitemap URLs for sitemap mode. Provide at least one URL; the legacy single `startUrl` key is also accepted.
startUrls.title: Start URLs

urlExcludePattern.description: Regular expression applied to every image URL and every page link. Example: '/blog/' skips blog pages and images.
urlExcludePattern.title: Skip URLs matching this regex (optional)

urlIncludePattern.description: Regular expression applied to every image URL and every page link. Example: '/products/' keeps only URLs containing that path.
urlIncludePattern.title: Only URLs matching this regex (optional)

userAgent.description: Override the default Chrome User-Agent string. Only needed if a server filters by user agent.
userAgent.title: Custom User-Agent (optional)

title: Website Image URL & Metadata Extractor
